_doc: ORDER-840 G1 stake ladder. Read only by systems/GambleStakeLadder.gd. In a full run the racetrack stakes and the hold'em buy-ins (and blinds) come from the highest tier the run has opened; outside a full run the tables keep their fixed lists. A tier opens at min_turn when any requires_any flag is set (empty = none needed), the run has made min_visits habit visits to that activity (BranchHabit), and cash is at least min_cash. Large tables can bankrupt; the 30억 tail stays out of reach outside the first-year hidden ending. Values are [첫 실행 재조정].
